findings.title: A second quit bypasses the pending shutdown wait
findings.evidence: Exact callback: first will-quit prevented; second not prevented while the same link.quit promise is still pending. No native ordering claim.
findings.correction: Keep a separate pending latch/promise; prevent every quit until it settles or the intended bound is reached, then mark done and issue the final quit.
